onboarding.tour.content.title: Your store's content
onboarding.tour.content.body: Your name, logo and phone are already on your store. Here you edit what makes it yours: the cover, your values, your story. Open a page to change its sections.
onboarding.tour.product.title: Add your first product
onboarding.tour.product.body: Your store shows what you add here. Create your first product with a name, price and photo.
onboarding.tour.store.title: See your online store
onboarding.tour.store.body: Open your store or share its link and QR code with your customers. You can replay this tutorial from your profile.
onboarding.restart.title: Welcome tutorial
onboarding.restart.description: Walk through the first steps again: your store's content, your first product and how to share it.
onboarding.restart.error: Couldn't restart the tutorial. Try again.
